ios.name: Tag Master
ios.subtitle: Learn barbershop tags
ios.description:
Tag Master puts the barbershop tag collection from BarbershopTags.com in your pocket. Find something new to sing, revisit an old favorite, or teach a tag to friends. Keep your afterglows glowing late into the night!

With Tag Master you can:
- Search for tags by name or lyrics.
- Save favorite tags and keep a separate list of tags you know how to teach.
- Organize tags into your own lists, such as "Easy tags" or "High and lows", and see at a glance which lists a tag belongs to.
- Browse Classic Tags, see the latest additions, or try a random tag.
- Filter by the number of voice parts and the availability of sheet music or learning tracks.
- Sort by title, downloads, date added, or rating.
- View sheet music and listen to learning tracks when available.
- Adjust the left/right balance on stereo tracks to bring out a part.
- Watch performance and teaching videos when available.
- Rate tags on BarbershopTags.com.
- Open tag links in the app and share favorites with friends.
- Press and hold the pitch button to hear a tag's starting note before you sing.

On a tablet, browse tags beside the selected tag's details. Light and dark appearances suit rehearsals and late-night singing alike.

Questions, problems, or feature requests? Email support@davidpoll.com.
ios.promotional_text: Find your next tag, hear the starting pitch, and keep favorites, teachable tags, and your own lists ready for your next afterglow.
